business_summary: Tamura Corporation manufactures and sells electronic components, electronic chemical packaging, and information equipment in Japan, China, other Asia, Europe, the United States, and internationally. The company offers electronic components, including transformers, reactors, choke coils, gate drivers, isolated DC-DC converter module, current sensors, high voltage power supplies, bolt-clamped langevin type transducers, SOLIDFORMER relay, piezoelectric transformer, transducers, and ultrasonic sensors products. It also provides solder pastes, carbon pastes, joint reinforcement paste, solder sheet, photo-imageable solder masks, materials for display, photosensitive coverlay film, flux, and OSP; reflow oven and flow soldering systems, spray fluxer, and other related equipment; and broadcast studio and communication systems. Tamura Corporation was founded in 1924 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
